about: Coverage plans: a scene laid out as shots. new = a new shot (a cut); otherwise the shot continues the one before in latent space, so the place, the light and the sound carry through. {a} and {b} are the first and second person of the scene, {place} its location. Lines are placeholders to replace.

plans.name: Arrive, sit, talk
plans.line: A bridge into a conversation instead of a jump.

shots.title: Arriving
shots.action: {a} and {b} walk into {place} side by side and look around.

shots.title: Sitting down
shots.action: {a} and {b} sit down facing each other.

shots.title: The conversation
shots.action: {a} and {b} sit facing each other and talk.

shots.title: The conversation goes on
shots.action: {a} leans forward a little.

shots.title: Master
shots.action: {a} and {b} stand in {place} and talk.

shots.title: Single on the first
shots.action: {a} listens and then answers.

shots.title: Single on the second
shots.action: {b} reacts and answers.

plans.name: Walk and talk
plans.line: Two people, one moving camera in front of them.

shots.title: Walk and talk
shots.action: {a} walks on the left and {b} on the right, side by side through {place}, talking.

shots.title: Still walking
shots.action: {a} and {b} keep walking side by side.

shots.title: They stop
shots.action: {a} and {b} slow down and stop.

shots.title: It starts
shots.action: {a} and {b} look up, startled, and start to run.

shots.title: Running
shots.action: {a} runs on the left and {b} on the right at the same speed, side by side toward the camera; the street behind them is empty.

shots.title: The car
shots.action: {a} and {b} reach a car parked at the curb on the left of the picture. {b} opens the driver's door; {a} walks around the front of the car to the passenger door on the far side. Both get in and shut their doors.

shots.title: Driving
shots.action: {b} drives, {a} sits in the passenger seat and looks back.

shots.title: Away
shots.action: The car drives away down the empty road.

shots.title: Detail
shots.action: A hand of {a} rests on the object.

shots.title: The face
shots.action: {a} looks up from the object, eyes widening a little.

shots.title: The place
shots.action: {a} stands small in {place}.

shots.title: Hero
shots.action: The product stands on a clean surface as light sweeps across it.

shots.title: In use
shots.action: {a} picks up the product, uses it and smiles.

shots.title: Pack shot
shots.action: The product alone, centred, turning slowly in the light.

plans.name: Music video verse
plans.line: Four short cuts for a verse.

shots.title: Performance wide
shots.action: {a} performs to the camera in {place}.

shots.title: Performance close
shots.action: {a} sings with closed eyes, then looks into the lens.

shots.title: Cutaway
shots.action: Hands on the instrument.

shots.title: The move
shots.action: {a} turns once as the light flares behind.
